info.title: Contraste dormant API
info.summary: Catalog row api 1.0.0: the read-only API of app/ (ADR-0057), dormant until the API lane is activated.
info.description: Serves the committed documents of data/derived unchanged, GET only. This file holds the paths and the error bodies by hand; frontend/scripts/gen-contract-types.mjs adds one component per schema file under docs/contracts/schemas/ and writes docs/contracts/api.openapi.json and frontend/src/lib/contract.gen.ts. Never edit the generated files.

get.summary: A variant or models artifact a manifest names, by its path under data/derived.
get.description: rel_path may contain slashes (for example C04/sp.json). The body is one of the variant and models schemas: the generator replaces x-discover with an anyOf over every component found under a case folder (variant* and models*), so a new case is served without editing this file.

c01-models.title: C01 models
c01-models.description: Catalog row c01-models 1.0.0: a C01 models artifact (one per fit_id: german, taiwan, taiwan-small).

c01-variant.title: C01 variant
c01-variant.description: Catalog row c01-variant 2.0.0: one C01 (retail PD) variant artifact. The default variant schema: its outputs carry no kind.

roc.description: The ROC of the champion and of every challenger within the group (51 points).

c01Irb.description: What C01's capital view states (CT-212, CT-214).

pd_floor_revolver.description: The QRRE revolvers' PD floor (null for other retail).

c01RetailParityPoint.description: One point of the retail risk weight, from riskvalidation, for the live port (CT-215).

reliability_raw.description: The same with the six-month full payers as transactors (the cards only; null for the loans).

targets.description: The observed outcome of each sampled applicant (1 = default).

c04-models.title: C04 models
c04-models.description: Catalog row c04-models 1.0.0: the C04 models artifact with the live parity points.

c04-variant-agency.title: C04 agency variant
c04-variant-agency.description: Catalog row c04-agency 1.0.0: one rating agency matrix with its TTC PD by grade (outputs.kind agency).

c04-variant-generator.title: C04 family variant
c04-variant-generator.description: Catalog row c04-family 1.0.0: one simulation family of the transition estimators (outputs.kind generator).

c04-variant-published.title: C04 published variant
c04-variant-published.description: Catalog row c04-published 1.0.0: printed values of the literature beside their recomputation (outputs.kind published).

c04Bounds.description: None for a grade without ratings, and for tab 3's events where they outnumber the cohort.

pd.description: Closed at 0 on purpose: the capital parity grid includes PD 0 (a grade with no default in any cohort), an engine input that probes the 0.05% floor of CRE32.4 and is not an estimated PD (data-pipeline/pipeline/cases/c04_parity.py:67-69, 154-160).

c04Cohort.description: One CEREP cohort on the common scale: tab 4's counts (seven grades by seven grades and default), withdrawals and sizes; tab 2's defaulted ratings over its own cohort; tab 3's events. Semester cohorts have no tab 2 or tab 3.

c04Generator.description: A generator of the pooled matrix: its rates, its L1 distance to the matrix, its PDs at one and five years (null by grade where the scale has no default category, Moody's).

c04Lifetime.description: One five-year window of the lifetime check (CT-415): the fixed cohort observed at the window's end against the chained one-year projections; a value is null where the chain or the definition does not exist.

c04Lra.description: The long-run average default rate by grade (EBA/GL/2017/16 paragraph 84) under one definition.

rate.description: null for a grade without a defined rate in any cohort

c04Performance.description: riskvalidation's estimator performance of a quantity by grade (Morris et al. 2019, Table 6): null by grade where fewer than two repetitions are defined.

c04Print.description: A printed value beside its recomputation; the bake stops unless they agree (contract section 3).

c04ProjectionPoint.description: The live parity of C04's models artifact (contract section 4), and the families' generator.

c04Rate.description: A harness rate: rejections (or hits) over n repetitions with its Monte Carlo SE and Wilson interval.

c04ScalarPerformance.description: The same for one quantity per repetition (the momentum hazard's fitted coefficient).

c05-models-ldp.title: C05 low-default models
c05-models-ldp.description: Catalog row c05-models-ldp 1.0.0: the C05 models artifact of the low-default fit (fit_id ldp).

c05-models-sp.title: C05 S&P models
c05-models-sp.description: Catalog row c05-models-sp 2.0.0: the C05 models artifact of the S&P fit (any fit_id but ldp).

c05-variant-ldp.title: C05 low-default portfolio variant
c05-variant-ldp.description: Catalog row c05-ldp 2.0.0: most prudent PD bounds of a low-default portfolio (outputs.kind ldp).

c05-variant-sp.title: C05 S&P calibration variant
c05-variant-sp.description: Catalog row c05-sp 2.0.0: the S&P calibration of one year (outputs.kind sp-calibration).

pd.description: The approach's own forecast of the unconditional PD.

pd_under_profile1.description: The PD its curve implies under the observed forecast profile.

c06-models.title: C06 models
c06-models.description: Catalog row c06-models 1.0.0: the C06 models artifact with the lifetime PD ladder, the PIT conversion, LGD, EAD and the staging policy.

c06-variant-reporting-date.title: C06 reporting-date variant
c06-variant-reporting-date.description: Catalog row c06-outputs 1.0.0: one reporting date of the mortgage lifetime PD, staging and ECL case (outputs.kind reporting-date).

c06AccountCurve.description: The SICR view's pair of curves for a sampled account: the origination forward curve against the current one over the same remaining window.

line_id.description: Equals the `id` of a `waterfall.lines[]` line (the model lines and `overlay-<overlay id>`), so the waterfall opens into the 35H table.

amount.description: Signed; a positive amount raises the allowance.

residual.description: closing - (opening + sum of movements) itself (a document may store it rounded to 1e-9); closure is judged against the reconciliation tolerance basis.

c06AllowanceRollForwardRow.description: Only a POCI allowance may be negative (IFRS 9 5.5.14); stage1 to stage3 openings and closings are not.

c06DataStatus.description: The data this document stands on. A variant without Freddie Mac data says so and why; nothing is invented.

c06DecileCalibration.description: Calibration at 12, 24 and 36 months per predicted-risk decile against the observed cumulative incidence (SDD row Lifetime PD rungs); an unobserved cell is null with its reason.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c06EclByScenario.description: Per-scenario ECL by stage at 100 per cent weight, model ECL without overlays. Staging is frozen: it is computed once at the weighted conditions and applied to every scenario row, so the weighted ECL equals the sum of weight times scenario ECL.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c06Fit.description: C06 fit: segments, the Fed-style scenario definitions, the TTC to PIT conversion, the lifetime PD ladder, LGD, EAD and the staging policy that the bake used.

amount.description: Signed; a positive amount raises the gross carrying amount.

residual.description: closing - (opening + sum of movements) itself (a document may store it rounded to 1e-9); closure is judged against the reconciliation tolerance basis.

origination_cohort.description: The origination cohort of the row (for example `2018`), or `all` for the pooled originations.

estimator.description: Aalen-Johansen cumulative incidence when prepayment competes, Kaplan-Meier otherwise.

c06LifetimeBacktest.description: Observed against predicted cumulative default by origination cohort and horizon (Aalen-Johansen when prepayment competes, Kaplan-Meier otherwise); a horizon not yet observed is null with its reason.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c06NonLinearity.description: The non-linearity panel: PD_PIT(z), the weighted PD against the PD at the weighted-average factor, and NL = ECL_weighted / ECL(mean path) - 1.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

scenarios.description: At least two probability-weighted scenarios (IFRS 9 5.5.17(a), B5.5.42); weights sum to 1.

c06Outputs.description: C06 reporting-date outputs (outputs.kind reporting-date): one reporting date of the lifetime PD, staging and ECL run. Money in `currency`; PD open (0, 1); horizons in months. A value the bake may lack is nullable with its reason. Staging parameters have one source, `settings` (the C06 models `staging_policy` repeats it field by field). Money identities of the reconciliation close by one tolerance basis (see `reconciliation`).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

stage.description: The stage whose allowance closing carries the overlay; null is portfolio level and is carried in the stage1 closing (a convention of the engine contract).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

tolerance.description: Relative: every identity closes when its absolute difference is at most tolerance * max(1, G), G being the total gross carrying amount of this document (the sum of the absolute closing amounts of `gross_carrying_amount`), in `currency`.

c06Reconciliation.description: IFRS 7 35H (allowance) and 35I (gross carrying amount) roll-forwards by stage; opening plus movements equals closing and residual is within the tolerance basis max(1, G) * tolerance (G the total gross carrying amount of the document). Each allowance `line_id` is a waterfall line id; each stage allowance closing equals the stage ECL plus the overlays carried in that stage.

eir_basis.description: The EIR basis of every non-POCI account; POCI accounts always use the credit-adjusted EIR (IFRS 9 5.5.13), whatever this value.

default_dpd.description: Days past due at which an account is Stage 3 (dpd >= default_dpd; the 90 dpd presumption of IFRS 9 B5.5.37).

low_credit_risk_pd.description: Annualised PD at or below which the quantitative SICR tests are suppressed (5.5.10); null when no exemption is used (then `low_credit_risk_exemption` is false). It never suppresses the dpd backstop, forbearance, watch-list, collective or default triggers.

sicr.description: The staging policy record (engine StagingPolicy). Only the 30 dpd and 90 dpd presumptions are IFRS 9; the threefold ratio is an EBA supervisory expectation; the rest are Contraste policy parameters.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

flows.description: A POCI account stays POCI for its life: a flow out of poci ends in derecognised or written-off.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c06StagingPolicy.description: The staging policy of the fit. The variant `outputs.settings.sicr` (with `settings.probation_months`) is authoritative: this block equals it field by field, and `low_credit_risk_pd` is null exactly when `low_credit_risk_exemption` is false.

c06TermStructure.description: h(t), q(t) = S(t-1) h(t) and F(t) = sum q, per scenario ('weighted' for the probability-weighted curve) and segment; the arrays are aligned with months and F is strictly increasing.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c06Waterfall.description: Opening to closing allowance. A positive amount raises the allowance and a negative amount lowers it; the opening line is the sum of the stage openings, every movement line is the sum over the stages of the reconciliation movements with the same `line_id`, and the closing line is the sum of the stage closings. Every overlay is its own line (kind overlay, overlay_id set, id `overlay-<overlay id>`), never merged into a model line.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c06WeightGrid.description: The scenario-weight simplex: ECL and the Stage 2 ratio with staging recomputed against staging frozen; each weights vector is aligned with scenario_ids and sums to 1.

c07-models.title: C07 models
c07-models.description: Catalog row c07-models 1.0.0: the C07 models artifact with the synthetic bank calibration and the transcribed regime tables.

c07-variant-three-regime.title: C07 three-regime variant
c07-variant-three-regime.description: Catalog row c07-outputs 1.0.0: the Chile provisions trilogy for one scenario variant (outputs.kind three-regime).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

minimum_check.description: The 0.50 per cent minimum on the individually assessed normal portfolio (categories A1 to A6), loans plus contingent credits; top_up is carried in regimes[cmf-b1] as the line minimum-top-up.

internal.description: The internal-method provision; null when the bank has no internal method (then internal_reason is set and method is standard).

additional_provisions.description: Counter-cyclical general provisions (B-1 N 9): their own line, outside the comparable total and never per segment.

booked_total.description: What the bank books under B-1: the comparable total plus the additional provisions.

c07B1Table.description: A transcribed CMF CNCB B-1 table; PI, PDI and PE are decimals (0.010916 is 1.0916 per cent) and, where both are set, PE = PI x PDI to the table's rounding. Closed at 0 and 1 on purpose: the default column is PI = 1 and the tables are statutory parameters, not estimates.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

coverage_rate.description: provision divided by the exposure of the category.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

rows.description: Segment provisions of the model only (by_segment); the unallocated lines are in `unallocated`.

unallocated.description: The sums of the unallocated lines of each regime; rows plus unallocated equal the regime totals.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.
ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

bde_segment.description: The Annex 9 segment code; the label is separate.

weighting_scenarios.description: At least two outcomes with weights summing to 1 (5.5.17(a), B5.5.42); the IFRS 9 regime of every variant is the weighted ECL over them.

eir_basis.description: EIR basis of the non-POCI accounts; POCI accounts use the credit-adjusted EIR.

doubtful_bucket_upper_days.description: Inclusive upper bound in days of each doubtful bucket (months at 30.4375 days rounded); null for the last, open bucket.

z_shift.description: The variant's shift of current conditions in systematic-factor units, added to every weighting scenario; 0 for base.

c07Fit.description: C07 fit: the synthetic Banco Andino calibration, the transcribed B-1 tables with their cells, the IFRS 9 parameters, the BdE Annex 9 coverage and the six scenario definitions.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c07GapBridge.description: The gap from the CMF B-1 comparable total to the IFRS 9 total (both as defined on `total_provision`) as exhaustive steps whose amounts sum to the gap exactly (an unexplained step is its own line). B-1 additional provisions are outside both totals and are not a step; the B-1 minimum top-up and the IFRS 9 overlays are.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

stage_summary.description: Model ECL excluding overlays, by stage.

overlays_total.description: Sum of overlays[].amount; regimes[ifrs9].total_provision = model ECL + overlays_total.

z.description: The systematic factor of the component: its weighting-scenario offset plus the variant shift.

single_scenario_ecl.description: A component of the weighted measure at 100 per cent weight; a sensitivity, never the IFRS 9 measure.

weighted_components.description: At least two scenarios whose weights sum to 1; the model ECL is the sum of weight times single_scenario_ecl (5.5.17(a), B5.5.42).

overlays.description: Each overlay is its own line, also an unallocated line of regimes[ifrs9]; never merged into by_segment or stage_summary.

c07Ifrs9Detail.description: The IFRS 9 regime of a scenario variant is a probability-weighted ECL over at least two scenarios, with the variant applied as a shift of current conditions (5.5.17(a), B5.5.42). A 100 per cent single-scenario ECL is never an IFRS 9 measure: it appears only as a weighted component or a sensitivity. The stage summary and the segment provisions carry the model ECL excluding overlays; overlays are their own lines.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

notice.description: Must say that the data are synthetic and that the IFRS 9 column is a comparison measure, not the provision Chilean banks book on loans (CMF B-1).

regimes.description: Exactly the three regimes in this order.

delta_vs_base.description: Null for the base scenario, the deltas against the base scenario for every other one.

c07Outputs.description: C07 three-regime comparison (outputs.kind three-regime): the same synthetic portfolio of Banco Andino under CMF B-1, IFRS 9 and BdE Annex 9 for one scenario variant. CMF B-1 is the statutory provision Chilean banks book on loans (IFRS 9 5.5 is carved out for loans in Chile); the IFRS 9 column is a comparison measure, not the Chilean statutory provision; BdE Annex 9 is the Spanish GAAP alternative solution, aligned with IFRS 9. Synthetic, never a statement about a bank. Every currency of the document is the same.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.
ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

total_provision.description: The comparable total: the sum of by_segment provisions plus the unallocated lines. cmf-b1: the statutory group-applied and individual provisions plus the minimum top-up (a line `minimum-top-up`); the additional provisions are outside this total (b1_detail.additional_provisions, booked_total). ifrs9: the probability-weighted model ECL plus the overlays (lines of kind overlay). bde-annex9: no unallocated line.

coverage_rate.description: total_provision divided by the sum of portfolio.gross_exposure over all segments.
provision divided by portfolio.gross_exposure of the segment.

by_segment.description: Segment provisions of the model only: for ifrs9 the model ECL excluding overlays; for cmf-b1 the group-applied and individual provisions excluding the minimum top-up.

by_category.description: Model provisions by category, excluding the unallocated lines.

status.description: cmf-b1: statutory for Chilean loans; ifrs9: comparison measure, not the Chilean statutory provision; bde-annex9: Spanish GAAP alternative solutions, IFRS 9 aligned.

unallocated_lines.description: Provision components in the total that no segment carries: the B-1 minimum top-up and the IFRS 9 overlays, each its own line.

c07StagingPolicy.description: The IFRS 9 staging policy of the C07 bake (same record as the C06 staging policy, engine StagingPolicy).

z_offset.description: Systematic-factor offset of this outcome around current conditions; the variant adds its z_shift.

c22-models.title: C22 models
c22-models.description: Catalog row c22-models 1.0.0: the C22 models artifact with the exact-probability parity points.

c22-variant.title: C22 validator variant
c22-variant.description: Catalog row c22-variant 1.0.0: one validation harness run (outputs.kind validator).

panels.description: axis: the x axis of a panel whose simulations do not run along the family's ladder; measures: whether its rates are

c22Parity.description: A point of the count tests' exact rejection probability, for the live calculator's parity (CT-308).

c22Rate.description: One rejection rate of the harness: rejections of n repetitions, its Monte Carlo SE and Wilson interval.

c22Simulation.description: One simulation: a registered test on one generator at one severity, its rates per rule ("p<0.05", "p<0.01", and rules such as "metric>0.1"), the exact probability where one exists and whether the rate agrees with it.

kind.description: Where the case's data comes from, for the case picker: observed data, a generator, or a published answer.

common-artifact-entry.title: Artifact entry
common-artifact-entry.description: One artifact a case manifest lists: a models artifact (no models_ref) or a variant artifact (models_ref names the models artifact its rungs come from).

short_title.description: The label a chip shows; `title` is the full name.

models_ref.description: Only on a variant entry: the path of the models artifact its rungs come from.

common-case-index.title: Case index
common-case-index.description: Catalog row case-index 1.0.0: the inventory of cases the site serves (data/derived/manifests/index.json).

files.description: Further files the site serves: the contract-1 declarations.

common-case-manifest.title: Case manifest
common-case-manifest.description: Catalog row case-manifest 1.0.0: one case (data/derived/manifests/<case>.json): its question, sources, artifacts and the contract-1 reports.

source_details.description: What the Context view shows of each source, from the source registry.

contract.description: The contract-1 report of each source the case read, keyed by source id.

expect.description: The checked expectation of the case: [low, high] per named result.

common-contract-family.title: Contract family
common-contract-family.description: Catalog row contract-family 1.0.0: one ingestion family declaration of contract 1 (data/derived/contract/<family>.json), exported from data-pipeline/pipeline/io/contract.py.

common-contract-index.title: Contract index
common-contract-index.description: Catalog row contract-index 1.0.0: the list of ingestion families (data/derived/contract/index.json).

common-contract-summary.title: Contract summary
common-contract-summary.description: The contract-1 report of one source a case read: counts, rule hits and examples.

common-finding.title: Finding
common-finding.description: One finding of a variant, with its severity and evidence.

common-gate-verdict.title: Gate verdict
common-gate-verdict.description: The lane gate of one artifact: whether the case ran live or precomputed and why.

common-impact-item.title: Impact item
common-impact-item.description: One quantified impact of a variant.

common-lane-block.title: Lane block
common-lane-block.description: The lane an artifact runs in and the reasons.

common-licence-manifest.title: Licence manifest
common-licence-manifest.description: Catalog row licence-manifest 1.0.0: what data-pipeline/fetch.py retrieved per source, with each file's hash, size and date (data/sources/manifest.json).

sources.description: Source id to what was fetched.

common-licences.title: Licences
common-licences.description: Catalog row licences 1.0.0: the verified licence of every Python engine the pipeline uses and the licences it forbids (data-pipeline/config/licences.json).

forbidden.description: Licence identifiers no dependency may carry.

python.description: Python package name to its verified licence.

common-model-record.title: Model record
common-model-record.description: A model with its internals (points tables, shape functions, grids), in a models artifact. details is open by design; the views read it through typed accessors.

short_title.description: The label a chip, a column header or a chart key shows ("P2b PLTR"); `title` is the full name.

checkpoint_sha256.description: The weights' hash for a fitted model; null for a formula (C05's approaches and estimators).

common-model-summary.title: Model summary
common-model-summary.description: One model of a variant artifact, without its internals.

short_title.description: The label a chip, a column header or a chart key shows ("P2b PLTR"); `title` is the full name.

checkpoint_sha256.description: The weights' hash for a fitted model; null for a formula (C05's approaches and estimators).

common-models-envelope.title: Models envelope
common-models-envelope.description: The keys every models artifact shares (abstract base: a case models schema composes it with its own fit). fit is open here and closed by the case.

common-provenance.title: Provenance
common-provenance.description: Where a variant or models artifact came from: inputs with hashes, licence classes, generators, seed and code versions.

common-readiness.title: Readiness
common-readiness.description: Catalog row readiness 1.0.0 (ADR-0080 decision 4): what is real in this build, per catalog row except readiness itself, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/core/readiness.py to data/derived/readiness.json from docs/contracts/catalog.md and the repository state, and read by the frontend and the dormant API. Deterministic: the product version and the catalog's SHA-256 identify it, no wall-clock time. The states and what each surface does with them: docs/contracts/catalog.md, section Missing-data states.

catalog_sha256.description: SHA-256 of docs/contracts/catalog.md (its UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalised to LF) the document was computed from.

common-source-details.title: Source details
common-source-details.description: What the Context view shows of one source, from the source registry.

common-source-registry.title: Source registry
common-source-registry.description: Catalog row source-registry 1.0.0: the hand-kept registry of every data source the product knows (data-pipeline/config/sources.json) with its licence class, access and fetch plan. doi and attribution are absent for a source that has none.

researched.description: The date the registry was researched.

common-test-result.title: Test result
common-test-result.description: One validation test row, the record riskvalidation writes as TestResult. extras is open by design.

common-text.title: Text
common-text.description: A bilingual reader-facing string (English and Spanish), as every reader-facing string is at the source.

common-variant-envelope.title: Variant envelope
common-variant-envelope.description: The keys every variant artifact shares (abstract base: a case variant schema composes it with its own outputs). outputs is open here and closed by the case; its optional string kind selects the case schema.

expected.description: The expected range in words, as a rejection states it.

status.description: The catalog's design status: real once the real producer serves the row, active while its provider does.

provenance.description: What actually served the row in this build; null when nothing did (state missing).

reason.description: Why the state is not available; null only when it is.

missing.description: For partial: what is absent (file paths, rejected record ids). Empty otherwise.

retrieved.description: The date the file was retrieved.

cases.description: The case ids that read the source.

unverified.description: What about the source is not yet verified on a primary page.

state.description: available: the real producer answered. partial: some of it exists (missing lists the rest). stale: an older bake answered (reason says how old). provider: the row's provider answered (provenance says which kind). training: a model slot answered with the released model or the baseline while a newer model trains, or with the baseline while no released model exists. missing: nothing answered.

text.description: Every reader-facing string is bilingual at the source.
